findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_hearing_notes · Private data: add_workspace_cases, get_hearing_note, mark_hearing_note_posted · Public sink: calculate_section_32_split, calculate_burns_lien, add_workspace_cases, calculate_slu_percent_from_rom, calculate_fee_split, list_hearing_notes · Destructive: describe_case_schema.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_hearing_notes · Private data: add_workspace_cases, get_hearing_note, mark_hearing_note_posted · Public sink: calculate_section_32_split, calculate_burns_lien, add_workspace_cases, calculate_slu_percent_from_rom, calculate_fee_split, list_hearing_notes · Destructive: describe_case_schema

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
